highlights: Store and organize passkeys for third-party websites — personal and shared — right alongside your passwords
Group by site automatically, mark favorites, see last-used, and manage passkeys like any other secret (rename, share, revoke, restore)
A companion Chromium browser extension for signing in with a stored passkey is rolling out now, with anti-phishing confirmation built in
Passkeys are encrypted at rest under your organization's key and governed by the same permissions and approvals as everything else in your vault
